symptomShortText: Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) detected 18 solder bridges on 0.4mm pitch QFN pins

defect.defectText: Solder bridging short circuit on fine-pitch QFN package

causesIshikawa.description: EMP-8104, Shift A - printer operator loaded approved stencil ST-QFN-04 and verified paste thaw time
Solder paste printer EQ-SMT02-001 squeegee pressure 0.22 kg/cm and separation speed 0.5 mm/s within spec
DOC-6610 Rev D - stencil wipe frequency set to every 3 prints with solvent-assisted vacuum wipe
Laser-cut stencil ST-QFN-04 fluoropolymer nano-coating degraded after 65,000 print cycles (limit 40,000), causing solder paste smear along aperture walls onto 0.4mm pads
3D Solder Paste Inspection (SPI) sensor GA-0902 calibrated and height repeatability confirmed
SMT cleanroom temperature 22.8C / 48% RH, within 20-25C and 40-60% RH envelope

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did PCBA-900 fail post-reflow automated optical inspection?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Adjacent pins on the 0.4mm pitch QFN microcontroller were shorted by solder bridges

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did solder bridge across the fine-pitch QFN pads?
fiveWhyChain.answer: Excess solder paste volume (165%) was deposited with paste bleed across aperture borders during printing

fiveWhyChain.question: Why did solder paste bleed across stencil apertures? (root cause)
fiveWhyChain.answer: The hydrophobic nano-coating on stencil ST-QFN-04 had worn off after 65,000 print cycles without scheduled replacement, allowing flux and paste adhesion to aperture undersides
fiveWhyChain.evidenceCitation: Tool tracking life record and contact angle measurement TR-2026-44

actions.actionText: Rework 48 bridged boards using hot-air micro-soldering and 100% X-ray inspection
Scrap worn stencil ST-QFN-04 and install new nano-coated laser stencil with verified 105 deg contact angle
Integrate RFID stencil life tracker into solder printer to automatically lock out stencils exceeding 40,000 prints

fmeaLink.description: Solder paste bridging due to stencil aperture nano-coating wear

lessonsLearned.whatWorked: SPI 3D volumetric threshold caught paste smear before boards entered reflow oven
lessonsLearned.whatDidnt: Stencil usage counting relied on manual spreadsheet entry instead of automated machine lockout

isIsNot.isWhereWhenItHappens: PCBA-900 fine-pitch QFN U12 on SMT Line 2 using stencil ST-QFN-04 on 2026-08-05
isIsNot.isNotWhereWhenItDoesnt: Large-pitch components (SOIC, 0805) or boards printed on SMT Line 1 with new stencil
isIsNot.notes: Defect exclusively concentrated on fine-pitch 0.4mm footprint where aperture wall release is critical
